label: Starfish
description: Keep doing, more of, less of, stop doing, start doing: a finer-grained take on start / stop / continue.

types.label: Keep doing
types.description: Working well; let's not lose it.

types.label: More of
types.description: Good, and we'd get more value doing it more.

types.label: Less of
types.description: Some value, but it costs more than it gives.

types.label: Stop doing
types.description: No longer helping us; drop it.

questions: What's one thing we'd stop today if nobody minded?
Which 'more of' would make the biggest difference next sprint?
aiGuidance: Group similar items. A 'stop' and a 'keep' about the same practice is a disagreement worth discussing: call it out rather than averaging it away. Turn the strongest 'start' items into concrete, owned action items.
